verdict.rationale: Nix ships with nixpkgs, an actively maintained repository documented as offering 140,000+ packages, searchable via `nix search`, installable via `nix-env`/`nix-shell`/`nix profile`, with community testimony confirming real-world use across diverse ecosystems (Python, C, custom ISOs). Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark of package freshness/update cadence beyond vendor claims.
